source_fields.formulation: Solve $\min_{x\in X} f(x)$ subject to the unknown expectation inequalities $g_i(x)=\mathbb E g_i(x,\xi)\le0$, $i=1,\ldots,m$, to the stated near-KKT criterion.

assumptions.description: The public set $X\subset\mathbb R^d$ is nonempty compact convex with diameter at most $D>0$ and a feasible point exists. The functions are finite on an open convex neighborhood of X. The objective is rho_f-weakly convex and each constraint is rho_g-weakly convex. Every ambient subgradient on X has norm at most l_f for f and l_g for each g_i.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

assumptions.description: Write $g_+(x)=\sum_i[g_i(x)]_+$. Public fixed constants $B>0$, $\bar\rho>\rho_g$ and $B_g>m\rho_gD^2$ satisfy: every $x\in X$ with $0<g_+(x)\le B_g$ admits $y\in\operatorname{relint}X$ such that $\max_i g_i(y)+(\bar\rho/2)\|y-x\|_2^2\le-B$. All structural, moment and qualification budgets are fixed as epsilon tends to zero.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

source_fields.operation: Three separately charged interfaces are available at any x in X. An objective-subgradient sample zeta_f has conditional mean in the ambient partial f(x) and conditional second moment at most S_f squared. A vector constraint-subgradient sample (zeta_gi) has conditional means in partial g_i(x) and conditional sum of squared norms at most S_g squared. A vector constraint-value sample G has conditional mean g(x) and centered conditional variance at most sigma_v squared. Fresh calls use independent randomness and the moment statements hold conditional on the history and selected query. A value observation may include an opaque sample handle for paid reuse at another point; every evaluation is charged. There is no free sampler revealing unknown constraint levels. Projection onto the known set and computation on known quantities are free.

source_fields.feasibility: Return $\widehat x\in X$. Validity is certified by existence of random latent witnesses $w\in X$ and $\lambda\in\mathbb R_+^m$; they need not be computed or returned and may live on an extension of the output probability space.

source_fields.base_expression: Require simultaneously $\mathbb E\|\widehat x-w\|_2\le\varepsilon$, $\mathbb E g_i(w)\le\varepsilon$ for every i, $|\lambda_i g_i(w)|\le\varepsilon$ almost surely for every i, and $\mathbb E\operatorname{dist}(0,\partial f(w)+\sum_i\lambda_i\partial g_i(w)+N_X(w))\le\varepsilon$. Feasibility is signed expected feasibility, not the expectation of its positive part. Complementarity is pathwise.

source_fields.budget: The native resource is $(N_{\rm obj},N_{\rm csub},N_{\rm cval})$. For prescribed pathwise subgradient caps $B_f,B_s$, optimize $\inf_A\sup_{P\in\mathcal P}\mathbb E_PN_{\rm cval}$ over algorithms meeting the complete near-KKT criterion and satisfying $N_{\rm obj}\le B_f$, $N_{\rm csub}\le B_s$ on every execution. Algorithms terminate almost surely. This is a conditional value-query complexity, not a full Pareto frontier of all three counters.
